headline: Premier League live updates: Man United face Bournemouth, Liverpool host Brighton
description: Both Liverpool and Manchester United are in Premier League action at the same time as a busy weekend of European soccer continues, with United boss Michael Carrick trying to save his job.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal, Man United, Liverpool track Bayern star Karl
description: Arsenal, Manchester United and Liverpool are monitoring Bayern Munich forward Lennart Karl. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man City beaten by Jackson's double for Aston Villa
description: Nicolas Jackson nets both goals for Aston Villa to end Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season with a 2-1 win at Villa Park.

headline: Spurs claim 2nd-ever Premier League win at Chelsea
description: A spectacular goal by Mathys Tel seals a 2-0 Spurs victory as Tottenham end their Stamford Bridge hoodoo with their second-ever win at Chelsea in the EPL era.

headline: Michael Carrick vows Man United will be 'different team' against Bournemouth
description: Michael Carrick has promised Manchester United fans they will see "a different team" against Bournemouth after the humiliating loss to Como.

headline: De Zerbi: Tottenham is a big club, and must show personality
